summary: Meta announced groundbreaking on its first Canadian data center, a 1GW AI-optimized facility in Sturgeon County, Alberta, representing over CAD $13 billion in investment.

mechanisms.reason: A new 1GW AI-optimized data center requires substantial new generation and grid infrastructure to be fully funded by Meta.
mechanisms.quote: We’re breaking ground on a new 1GW, AI-optimized data center in Alberta, Canada that will help power our AI innovations and core products.

mechanisms.reason: The document states a disclosed capital commitment of over CAD $13 billion for a new AI data center build-out.
mechanisms.quote: Once complete, our Sturgeon County data center will represent an investment of more than CAD $13 billion.

notable_reason: A disclosed 1GW, CAD $13 billion data center commitment with named grid partners is a concrete, quantified infrastructure build-out relevant to power and datacenter capacity trends.
